name: Ryan Pfefferle
career_history: Energy Program Manager  at Microsoft, 7/2024 to present; Energy Manager at Oxy, 5/2022 to 7/2024; Portfolio Management Analyst at PG&E, 5/2020 to 5/2022; Power Engineer at Oxy, 9/2017 to 1/2020; Power Engineer at Occidental, 9/2017 to 1/2020; Process Supervisor at Occidental, 5/2016 to 9/2017; Process Supervisor at Oxy, 5/2016 to 9/2017; Process Engineer at Oxy, 6/2015 to 5/2016; Process Engineer at Occidental, 6/2015 to 5/2016; Process Engineering Intern at Oxy, 5/2014 to 8/2014; Process Engineering Intern at The Mosaic Company, 1/2013 to 6/2013

biography:
As an experienced Energy Manager with 8 years in the industry, I have a deep understanding of the energy landscape and a proven track record of implementing cost-effective and sustainable energy solutions. My expertise in regulations, power solutions, and compliance has allowed me to effectively manage energy consumption, reduce costs, and enhance operational efficiency for a variety of organizations. My passion for sustainability and commitment to continuous improvement have led to successfully manage multiple project. 

One of my favorite projects is I took on the role of developing an operations and maintenance plan for a 16.8 MW solar farm. Despite no experience in the solar industry, I leveraged my expertise in building relationships to cultivate new partnerships in this sector and spent countless hours learning about solar. After developing an RFQ, reviewing 6 proposals, and negotiating with the chosen company, I executed the operations and management (O&M) contract in less than 6 months, delivering the project ahead of schedule.

Core competencies: Energy Manager, Project management, program management, analysis and forecasting, strategic planning, risk identification, negotiations, performance tracking, proposal development, business case modeling, regulatory compliance, reporting, operations management, team leadership, training and coaching, scheduling, problem resolution
